Container.Name: scum
Container.Overview:
SCUM Dedicated Server with Proton support.
Based on Debian 13 (Trixie) with GE-Proton for running the Windows dedicated server on Linux.
**Data layout (all under /data):** - /data/server/ — game server files (~8GB) - /data/config/ — server config (ServerSettings.ini and others) - /data/saves/ — world save data - /data/logs/ — server.log - /data/backups/ — automated daily backups
**First Run:** - Container downloads ~8GB of game files on first start - Server name, password and other settings are written to /data/config/ServerSettings.ini on first run — edit it and restart to apply
**Ports:** SCUM uses three consecutive ports; players connect on the game port + 2 (7779 by default).

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Stores server files (/server), saves (/saves), config (/config), logs (/logs), and backups (/backups).

Config.Name: Disable BattlEye
Config.Description: Set true to launch without the BattlEye anti-cheat (not recommended).

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Game client port (UDP). The raw (game+1) and query (game+2) ports follow it.

Config.Name: Query Port
Config.Description: Steam query / player-connect port (game port + 2, TCP).

Config.Name: Validate Files
Config.Description: Re-validate game files on each start (true/false). Slow but fixes corruption.

Config.Name: Game Config
Config.Description: Game preset selector. Do not change.

Config.Name: Steam App ID
Config.Description: SCUM Dedicated Server App ID. Do not change.
